visualCharacteristics.purpose: background photo banner with an inset box holding heading, text and a CTA

contentPattern.structure: background picture (own row or cell) + content cell: heading, text, optional CTA links. Order does not matter; image or CTA may be missing

reuseGuidance: Use for promo banners with a photo behind a text box. The colour options (Orange, Blue, Cyan, Grey) also switch the box to a wide layout with the CTA on the right. For page titles beside a photo use hero-page.
